recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a male figure in a mustard-yellow sweater set against a blurred, sun-drenched hillside, topped with bold, shadowed retro typography.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast cream typography against a dark green natural background
Color harmony between the subject's mustard sweater and the warm highlights of the landscape
Vertical hierarchy with text anchored at the top and the subject positioned in the lower two-thirds
Depth created through a shallow depth of field and heavy 3D drop shadows on the text
coreInvariants: Heavy black drop shadow on primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a male figure, positioned slightly off-center to the right, filling the bottom half of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold name text at the top of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large cream text, moves down to the subject's face, and follows the line of the sweater into the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blurred hillside provides a textured but non-distracting negative space for the text to sit upon.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, earthy saturation with high value contrast between the text and the background.

letterConstructionRules: Hard-edged, solid black drop shadows offset to the bottom right
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' features a tight, aggressive curve
The 'J' has a short, blunt hook
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, heavy sans-serif for the name paired with a wide, light serif for the header text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and blunt terminals of the main name text.
Approximates the wide, small-serif header text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s style film photograph of a man in a mustard yellow zip-up sweater standing in front of a blurred green hillside. Use warm, vintage color grading and visible film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the header text in a wide, cream-colored serif font with high tracking at the top. Below it, add the main name in an extra-bold cream sans-serif with a thick, solid black drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the drop shadow solid and opaque?
Is the sweater color specifically mustard yellow?
Is the background sufficiently blurred to keep text legible?

postGenerationChecks: Check for film grain consistency across the image.
Ensure the drop shadow direction is consistent.
Verify the cream color isn't too close to pure white.
Confirm the subject's pose feels candid and era-appropriate.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Portrait + Earthy Palette + Heavy Drop-Shadow Sans
